package consumer
import (
    "context"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/api/input"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/validation"
)
type row struct{}
type other struct{}
var body input.Body[row]
var _, _ = input.NewList(body, input.ListConfig{MaxItems: 1}, input.ListValidator[other](func(context.Context,other)(validation.Errors,error){return validation.Errors{},nil}))
